Dr. Goodfellow, of the London (Eng.) Technical college, in giving some hints concerning the proper preparation of cocoa, says:

"Start with a pure cocoa of undoubted quality and excellence of manufacture, and which bears the name of a respectable firm. This point is important, for there are many cocoas on the market which have been doctored by the addition of alkali, starch, malt, kola, hops, etc."
Examine the package you receive and make sure that it bears our trade-mark.
Under the decisions of the U. S. Courts no other Cocoa is entitled to be labeled or sold as "Baker's Cocoa."
